headline: Translator and Bilingual Support Specialist
summary: Arabic–English translator and bilingual support specialist with three years at an outsourcing company. I translate customer documents and chats, interpret on calls between Arabic-speaking customers and English-speaking staff, and proofread translated text. I also handle email and chat support for Middle East clients.

experience.title: Bilingual Support Specialist
bullets: Translate customer documents, invoices and chats between Arabic and English for a travel company's Gulf clients.
Interpret on calls when customers prefer Arabic, keeping meaning and tone accurate.
Answer about 50 customer emails and chats a day in Arabic and English.
Proofread translations done by two junior translators before they are sent.

experience.title: Arabic Tutor and Translator
bullets: Taught basic Arabic reading to adult learners and translated the center's notices.
Interpreted for visiting speakers at community events.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Islamic Studies, major in Arabic Language
education.school: Western Mindanao College of Islamic Studies
